summary: Table.search now bypasses the query cache (both lookup and store) for queries that contain a fragment() test, detected by the new static helper Table._is_fragment_query, which walks nested and/or/not query descriptions. Other queries are cached as before.
self_check: python -m compileall -q tinydb: ok. python -c 'import tinydb': ok. python -m mypy tinydb: Success, no issues found in 10 source files. python -m pytest -q: 228 passed. Reproduced the issue's example: home fragment -> 1 doc, work fragment -> [] (was 1 doc before the change); count(work fragment) == 0.
